scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to the stated planar polynomial family with strictly positive coefficients and integer order at least one. Its physical-time coefficient and order threshold need not extend to other angular bottlenecks or perturbations. A related 2025 article could only be inspected through its abstract, leaving historical-priority uncertainty. Finite computations supplement an analytic proof, and independent validation is not performed.
title: A sharp monodromy threshold and physical-time winding law for polynomial angular bottlenecks
